1.d4 e6 2.c4 c5 3.Nf3 cxd4 4.Nxd4.strategy: Recaptures with a developing move and centralises the knight, where it eyes e6, c6 and b5. White keeps the c-pawn as a space edge on the queenside, and Black has to deal with the active knight.

1.d4 e6 2.c4 c5 3.Nf3 cxd4 4.Nxd4 Nf6.strategy: Develops the knight to its natural square, where it controls e4 and d5. That brakes White's attempt to build a broad centre with e4 and prepares quick castling. Black accepts a little less space for a solid, easy game.
1.d4 e6 2.c4 c5 3.Nf3 cxd4 4.Nxd4 Nf6.name: English Opening: Symmetrical Variation, Anti-Benoni Variation, Spielmann Defence
